messages:
Aisha_CS: Quick sync — can we do a dry‑run of the QBR deck tomorrow 11am PT? Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDE_example (deck in qbr/2026). Need clear owners for slides, the live demo, and exec talking points. Also note renewal risk for Meridian (Sofia flagged). Please reply with owners + any blockers by EOD.

Marco_Research: I'm available and can take the metrics & usage slides. Will add NPS, DAU/MAU, and a short cohort chart. :white_check_mark:

Priya_Eng: I can own infra/uptime and reliability slides. Need p90/p99 latency numbers from runtime — @Tom_K can you drop them here? Also will call out the recent autoscale change.

Tom_K: P90=210ms, P99=620ms (last 7d). Pushing numbers into the deck now. I'll volunteer to run the live demo and prepare a fallback plan in case the model stalls. Quick fallback snippet for the runbook:
```
if demo.latency > 2s:
  switch_model('redwood-small-v1')
  notify('#release-war-room', "Demo fallback: switched to small model")
```

Sofia_G: Re Meridian — they've paused the SSO integration sprint and cited stability concerns. Risk: HIGH. Recommend a 30‑day win plan (staged deliverables + weekly checkpoints). I'll draft the exec email and an ask list for finance re: extension/discount.

ebr-bot: Reminder: Dry‑run checklist NOT OK — missing: renewal mitigation owner, demo fallback documented, exec talking points in slide notes. Please address before the dry‑run.

Aisha_CS: Thanks team — immediate action items:
- Marco_Research -> metrics & cohort breakdown (due: EOD today)
- Priya_Eng -> infra & uptime slide (add p90/p99)
- Tom_K -> demo + fallback script + runbook (upload test notes)
- Sofia_G -> Meridian email draft + mitigation plan
- Aisha_CS -> consolidate exec talking points & send updated invite
Please add your name in slide notes and update the tracker tab in the deck. Meeting tomorrow 11am PT sharp. :raised_hands:

Priya_Eng: Added slide notes and updated p90/p99 numbers. Pinged runtime for validation. Deck now v1.0.

Marco_Research: Uploaded metrics + cohort breakdown. Left two TODOs about churn attribution (need product input).

Tom_K: Demo script uploaded to the deck, fallback tested locally. Attached short runbook in slide notes. :thumbsup:

Sofia_G: Draft email for Meridian posted to Confluence (link in deck notes). Tagged @Aisha_CS and @FinanceOps for the discount ask. Also added a 30‑day milestone table.

Aisha_CS: Perfect — I'll consolidate all updates, create the action tracker sheet, and send the updated invite + calendar attachment. If you can't make 11am PT, reply here with a proposed alternate. Otherwise we'll assume attendance. End of thread.
